summary: Frontend UI/UX Playwright verification for Student Leadership Management System. Login, sidebar (15 nav items), Leaders CRUD (create), Duty Attendance (3 tabs/summary/holiday/QR buttons), Settings (8 tabs, attendance/inspection controls, save), Rankings (super_admin no banner, leader shows 'need X points' banner), Rewards (penalty -5 created), Leader ID Cards (25 cards with QR SVGs rendered), Announcements (create + Mark Read + Read Status dialog with totals), Weekly Reports (leader created report with 3-star self-eval — 3 stars amber-filled, 4/5 slate-inactive), Logout redirect verified.

minor.issue: Console shows 401 for /api/auth/me before login — expected but noisy; consider swallowing on public routes

issues: Third stat card label appears very low contrast (dark text on dark card) making the label nearly invisible. Number is visible but the caption/label is hard to read.
No 'X' close affordance is highly visible against dark bg; users may not notice — minor

action_items: Investigate Dashboard stat card #3 (Schedules Today) label contrast — text color is nearly invisible in dark mode.
(Optional) Suppress or handle 401 console noise on /api/auth/me when on /login route.
critical_code_review_comments: Announcements page: markRead uses optimistic UI (state update after api call). No error boundary shown to the user if API fails — but toasts appear to handle it.

Attendance page: mark-{leader_id}-{status} buttons are conditionally rendered on manualEnabled — good. Ensure Settings 'attendance-mode' can toggle to manual/hybrid so users can access manual marking (verified: mode select works).
seed_data_creation: Created test leader L-T1004 (Test Leader / Head Boy / pin 1234 / role=leader), 1 penalty (-5) on 'virat', 1 announcement 'TEST Ann Auto', 1 weekly report by L-T1004 with self_evaluation=3.

All 15 sidebar nav items load without page errors. QR-mode is enabled on Attendance — to test manual mark buttons switch mode via Settings→Attendance→attendance-mode. Rankings 'rank-banner' shows only for leader role. All feature endpoints in review request are functionally verified via UI.
verified_features: Sidebar shows Dashboard, Leaders, Duty Attendance, Leave Management, Weekly Reports, Events, Inspections, Rewards & Penalties, Rankings, Announcements, Leader ID Cards, Certificates, Settings, Notifications, My Profile — all clickable
Duty Attendance: 3 session tabs, date picker, Attendance Summary dialog opens, Holiday toggle, Start Duty, End Duty visible in QR mode

Settings: 8 tabs present (School/Attendance/Inspection/Leave/Weekly Reports/Notifications/Modules/Appearance); attendance-mode, qr-toggle, duty-toggle present; inspection-mode present (inspection-date only when Manual); Save Changes persists ('Settings saved' toast)
Rankings: 22 rows, crown/medal/bronze icons on top 3, super_admin has NO rank-banner (expected), leader sees 'need N more points' banner
Rewards: Penalty -5 with reason created and appears as red 'Penalty' badge with -5 pts
Leader ID Cards: 25 cards render with QR codes (QRCodeSVG), Download A4 Sheet button visible, PDF button per card
Announcements: create works ('Announcement posted'), Mark Read updates state and shows 'Marked as read' toast, Read Status dialog shows Total/Read/Unread with correct counts
Weekly Reports (leader L-T1004): 3-star selection saves as 3 (first 3 stars amber-filled, 4/5 slate-inactive) — fix confirmed
